evidence: Offline synthetic Git fixtures and scripted review responses
protocol: - Run the ten caller selection cases and the four public review assignment cases once per checkout. Require 10/10 and 4/4 on the candidate. Check the three newly reported failures with public-entry-point regression tests, including compatible controls and pinned-plan replay.

- Compare graph enrichment on v0.1.7 and the repaired checkout. Use two warm-ups and nine alternating timed calls per arm and workload. Require full output parity, zero errors, at least 25% median reduction on medium and many, and at most 10% slowdown on the other two. Report peak traced allocations separately.

- Repeat the original preview protocol with its exact performance-only projection over v0.1.7, verified by patch digest. Check full-output parity, process counts, one warm-up and five alternating timed calls per arm/workload. Require at least 15% lower median wall time on both 80-file workloads.

- Confirm preview performance also on the complete fixed checkout. For this second pair, give the baseline the candidate's caller policies and retain v0.1.7 source reading and planner lookup, so the intentional policy fields and affected-unit IDs agree. Apply the same frozen fixtures, metrics and gates.

- Replay the frozen second-pass recording once with one pass and once with two through the repaired checkout. Match the historical case statuses (five complete on one pass, four complete and the c05 unknown-usage case partial on two passes), 1/2 and 2/2 unique known defects confirmed respectively, zero false or duplicate confirmations. The separate historical gate requires live quality and observed billing and is expected to remain unevaluated in this offline run.
